prompt.name: Grenadier
prompt.look: An 18th-century grenadier: a tall, broad-shouldered adult man with a trimmed brown moustache, wearing a tall brass-fronted mitre cap with a short tassel, a knee-length coat with brass buttons and wide turned-back cuffs, a white cross-belt over the chest, a black leather grenade pouch with a small brass badge at his right hip, light grey breeches, white gaiters over black shoes, and a short musket slung across his back. In his right hand he holds a round black iron grenade the size of an apple with a short fuse; his left hand is free.
prompt.identity: the same face and moustache, tall mitre cap, red coat with turned-back cuffs, white cross-belt, black grenade pouch, grey breeches, white gaiters, black shoes, slung musket and round black grenade
prompt.weapon_pose: He stands with the round grenade held at chest height in his right hand and his left hand hanging at his side; the musket is slung across his back, its barrel rising behind his left shoulder. The grenade is well above his knees and nowhere near his shoes.
prompt.attack: (1) ready, grenade held at the chest; (2) a tiny orange spark at the end of the short fuse, the grenade still in his right hand; (3) he draws his right arm back behind his head, leaning back; (4) he swings the arm forward over his shoulder, body twisting toward the right; (5) the throw: the arm fully extended to the right, the grenade still held in his fingertips at the end of the swing; (6) recover, arm lowered, standing upright, the grenade back in his right hand at chest height.
prompt.damage_gear: a dented mitre cap and a scuffed, torn coat
prompt.damage_gear_critical: a crumpled mitre cap hanging askew and a badly torn coat with a ripped sleeve
prompt.defeat_prop: the round grenade still held loosely in his hand, its fuse dark

states.note: walk built in code from the master and from each damage drawing; the legs alternate by construction
